basic_details.short_information: The Principal District and Sessions Court, Kodagu-Madikeri (Kodagu District Court), Karnataka, has released four recruitment notifications inviting online applications for 39 posts across the Kodagu district judiciary - Typist (8 posts), Driver (2 posts), Process Server (6 posts), and Peon/Attender (23 posts). All four notifications were issued on 28-08-2026 under direct recruitment, per the Karnataka Subordinate Courts (Clerical and Other Posts) (Recruitment) Rules, 1982, as amended in 2007 and 2021. Eligible candidates can apply online from 03-09-2026 to 03-10-2026 (11:59 PM) through the off

application_fee.details: Fees must be paid online only, through the SBI e-Pay Payment Portal linked on the court website, via net banking, credit card, debit card, UPI, or QR code. Cash, Demand Draft, Postal Order, Money Order, and Challan are not accepted. Applications with unpaid fees will be rejected, and paid fees are non-refundable under any circumstances.

age_limit.details: Minimum age: 18 years as on the last date for submitting applications Maximum age - General candidates: 40 years Maximum age - Category 2(A), 2(B), 3(A), 3(B): 43 years Maximum age - SC/ST/Category-1: 45 years A one-time 5-year relaxation in the maximum age limit applies as per Government Order dated 29-01-2026, subject to the ceilings above after adjustment Further age relaxations apply for government/local-authority/corporation employees, ex-servicemen, NCC cadet instructors, Grama Sujaga Parishilakas, persons with disability (10 years), Census enumerators, widows (10 years), and released bonded labourers (10 years), as specified in the notifications | Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

qualification.details: Pass in 2nd PUC conducted by the Karnataka Department of Pre-University Education, or a 3-year Diploma in Commercial Practice, or an equivalent qualification (CBSE/ICSE Class 12, other state board Class 12, NIOS Senior Secondary course, or a 3-year diploma/2-year ITI/2-year vocational diploma combined with the specified NIOS language and subject courses), obtained by the last date for applying. In addition, a pass in the Senior Grade Typewriting examination (Kannada and English) conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board, or a Diploma in Secretarial Practice, or equivalent, is required. Computer knowledge is essential, and as per High Court orders, the Kannada and English typing tests will be conducted on computer using the "Kwenpu-Nudi" Kannada typing keyboard layout. | Pass in SSLC or equivalent, and a current Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence. | Pass in SSLC or equivalent. how_to_apply: Visit the official website, https://kodagu.dcourts.gov.in/online-recruitment/, and select the relevant recruitment link.
Register with a valid, currently active mobile number and email ID - the court is not responsible if candidates cannot be reached via SMS or email due to incorrect details.
Fill in the online application form completely and accurately; incomplete or incorrect applications will be rejected.

Upload a scanned colour passport photograph (5 cm x 3.6 cm, under 50 KB, .jpg format, white background, unsigned) and a scanned signature in black ballpoint pen on white paper (2.5 cm x 7.5 cm, under 25 KB, .jpg format).
Upload a clear scanned copy, in PDF format, of the qualifying examination marks card (2nd PUC/equivalent for Typist; SSLC/equivalent for Driver, Process Server, and Peon).
Pay the application fee online through the SBI e-Pay Payment Portal before the deadline.
Submit the application, then download and retain a copy of the submitted application and fee receipt until the recruitment process is complete; produce it at the time of the skill test/interview.
Candidates should apply well before the last date, without waiting until the deadline.

Only one application per candidate is allowed; if more than one is submitted, only the last one is considered valid and the rest are rejected. No information can be edited after submission. Applications submitted through any mode other than online will not be considered.
important_instructions: Candidates claiming reservation must hold the prescribed certificates (Form-D for SC/ST, Form-E for Category-1, Form-F for Categories 2A/2B/3A/3B) valid as on the last date for applying, issued by the concerned Tahsildar with signature, seal, or bar code/hologram/watermark. Candidates claiming rural reservation must hold certificates countersigned by the Head Master and the concerned Block Education Officer. Candidates claiming persons-with-disabilities reservation must hold a medical certificate in the prescribed format (per Government notification dated 19-11-2005) from a District-level Medical Board. Ex-servicemen claiming reservation must hold their discharge/release certificate from military service by the last date. Candidates already employed in State/Central Government or public sector undertakings must mention their service details in the application and, if selected, furnish a No-Objection Certificate from their department. Candidates must obtain conduct certificates from two respectable persons and their last educational institution, within 6 months of the application date. Selected candidates will be on probation for two years, as per the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules, 1977, and must pass the prescribed departmental examinations and the Kannada language examination during this period. Selected candidates will be covered under the National Pension Scheme (NPS). Candidates called for interview/skill test attend at their own expense; those not selected have no claim for correspondence with the court regarding the selection. Post-wise and category-wise details are subject to revision as per government orders issued from time to time. If information or certificates furnished by a candidate are found false or fabricated during document verification, the candidature/selection will be cancelled and criminal prosecution may follow. Special note: the recruitment order issued pursuant to these notifications is subject to the final orders of the Hon'ble Karnataka High Court in W.P. Nos. 200448/2025, 17968/2025, and 3145/2023.

content_sections.heading: Kodagu Court Vacancy 2026 – Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The PWD post is reserved for candidates with "Blind and low vision" disability; if unavailable, it will be carried forward to a future recruitment. The PWD post is reserved for Locomotor disability (including cerebral palsy, leprosy-cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims, and muscular dystrophy). The SC Category-C post is reserved for 59 specified Most Backward castes within SC Category-C; if unavailable, it will be filled from other SC Category-C castes.

faq.question: Q1. What is Kodagu District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the Principal District and Sessions Court, Kodagu-Madikeri, for 39 posts of Typist, Driver, Process Server, and Peon/Attender, released across four separate notifications dated 28-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Kodagu District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 39 vacancies in total: 8 Typist (including 1 backlog post), 2 Driver, 6 Process Server, and 23 Peon/Attender posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for Kodagu District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the fee is 03-10-2026, up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Kodagu District Court Typist posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a pass in 2nd PUC or an equivalent qualification, along with a pass in the Senior Grade Typewriting examination in Kannada and English, or an equivalent secretarial qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Driver, Process Server, and Peon posts?
faq.answer: All three require a pass in SSLC or an equivalent qualification. The Driver post additionally requires a current Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence, and a driving licence is preferred for Process Server applicants.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Kodagu District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age is 40 years for General candidates, 43 years for Categories 2A/2B/3A/3B, and 45 years for SC/ST/Category-1 candidates, as on the last date for applying, with further relaxations available in specific cases.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for Kodagu District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹300 for General candidates and ₹150 for Categories 2A/2B/3A/3B, payable only online via the SBI e-Pay portal. SC, ST, Category-1, and PWD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for Kodagu District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online only, through https://kodagu.dcourts.gov.in/online-recruitment/, by the last date. No offline or other mode of application is accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Kodagu District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on qualifying-exam marks combined with a computer typing skill test for Typist posts, a driving test for Driver posts, and a shortlisting ratio followed by an interview for Process Server and Peon posts.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Typist and Driver posts carry the pay scale of ₹34,100–67,600; Process Server carries ₹31,775–61,300; and Peon/Attender carries ₹27,000–46,675, plus applicable allowances.
